model.title: A resolution designating October 30, 2026, as a national day of remembrance for the workers of the nuclear weapons program of the United States.

summary.text: The resolution designates October 30, 2026, as a national day of remembrance for workers of the United States nuclear weapons program, including uranium miners, millers, and haulers, plutonium processors, and people who took part onsite in atmospheric nuclear weapons tests. It also encourages people across the country to take part in ceremonies, programs, and other activities that honor both past and present workers of the program on that day.
